description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut #7; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 assets). Fixes an inline-smali syntax error in the Gemini 'Google app missing: open Gemini in browser' patch (register-set invoke form) so it applies cleanly — re-cut #6 is superseded. Adds the browser fallback for the 'Download or enable the Google app' dialog: recent Gemini builds host the chat inside the Google app, so the dialog is replaced by gemini.google.com/app in the browser. Pre-migration Gemini builds (1.0.776555963, 1.0.608774175) are registered as experimental targets for in-app, Google-app-free use with the MicroG integration patch. Carries re-cut #5 (Gemini MicroG integration), #4 (Gemini permission/privacy patches), #3 (Mereframe all-bridge sweep, #34/#35/#29) and #2 (Netflix Android TV).
